elements_selected.content: Add the blake3 crate to Cargo.toml as a regular (non-optional) dependency. Per ADR-008, blake3 is selected over SHA-256 for speed (~5 GB/s vs ~500 MB/s) and its built-in Merkle tree design. Add: blake3 = '1' to [dependencies]. Verify cargo check passes. The binary size increase (~100 KB) is acceptable per ADR-008.
